Body.Content:
A business function gives Sales Research Agent the context and instructions it needs for a specific use case, such as account planning, territory planning, pipeline review, or engagement analysis. Business Function Builder creates that configuration from your data, schema metadata, and optional reference content, so you don't author every field by hand.

What's new

Create a business function from a natural-language description of your use case.

Let the agent discover the relevant tables (including custom tables), columns, and relationships.

Evaluate the business function against your real data, with graded test questions that show where it's wrong and why.

Promote test questions to starter prompts, and give each one a default blueprint so every user gets the same answer shape from their own data.

Share a validated business function with users and roles in your organization.

GA date: March CY2027

Preview date: November CY2026
